rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for having tact or knowing what is appropriate to say and do.

example.english: They have a lot of tact; even when they have to criticize someone, they do not make them feel bad.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢好有分寸，就算要批評人都唔會令人難受。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 fan1 cyun3 zau6 syun3 jiu3 pai1 ping4 jan4 dou1 m4 wui5 ling6 jan4 naan4 sau6

rows.note: Use this when “tact” means ordinary good manners or polite behaviour rather than sensitivity in handling a situation.

example.english: Show tact when eating with other people, and do not keep using your phone.
example.traditional: 同人食飯時要有禮貌，唔好一路撳電話。
example.jyutping: tung4 jan4 sik6 faan6 si4 jiu3 jau5 lai5 maau6 m4 hou2 jat1 lou6 gam6 din6 waa2
